name: workflow-loom
title: WorkflowLoom
description: Arazzo workflow as a loom: fluid columns (inputs, steps, outputs), lanes per source, step nodes, data threads with their consumers, parallel branches (dependsOn), end and retry actions, an expression lens, and an equivalent Steps table.

a11y.pattern: role=group with toggle-button nodes (aria-pressed), roving tabindex, lens toggle buttons (inputs, outputs, thread labels), and an optional Show as table view
keyboard: Moves to the Show as table button (unless tableToggle is false), the diagram region, the inputs, the loom (one tab stop for all steps), the outputs, then the thread labels
Moves to the previous or next column
Moves to the previous or next lane or parallel branch in the same column
On a step: selects it, or clears the selection when it is already selected (mkStepSelect). On an input, an output or a thread label: traces it, or clears the lens (mkLensSelect)
aria: Every node is a button named by its visible content, with a hidden "Step" prefix and hidden check states: "Step 3 patchPastry PATCH /pastries/{name} Failed after 3 attempts Success criteria passed Schema validation failed 200 · 3 attempts · 5.4 s"; the drawing marks (warp, heddles, lines, end and retry marks) are aria-hidden
Actions (end, retry) and the AsyncAPI "not runnable" note are in the node's aria-describedby
Status is words plus a circled icon: Passed, Failed, Not run (dashed outline, never reduced opacity)
Inputs, outputs and thread labels are aria-pressed buttons whose name starts with hidden "Trace …" text followed by the visible expression and value; drop chips carry hidden "to step …" text
Dimmed threads keep readable text colours (only lines and dots fade)

Show as table (aria-pressed) swaps the diagram for a real table: #, Step, Source, Operation, Depends on, Status, Checks, Actions, then the data threads in words. Pages with their own Steps table set tableToggle to false
The scrollable diagram and table are focusable regions with a name
a11y.notes: Copy the element bundle with the wrapper (elements/workflow-loom.js is self-contained). Angular: add schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA] to the host component. No goto: Arazzo actions are limited to end and retry in the Microcks POC. The loom reads the tokens (proto-*, on-proto, link, border, border-strong, canvas, selected, success, danger), so load tokens.css. Legacy data still works: inputs/outputs as strings and threads as { from, to, expression } are woven into one row per expression.
